device_entry.description: 一款多通道可编程直流电源，可为电子电路、器件或原型系统提供可调直流电压与电流输出，并支持分通道开关与输出测量，常用于实验室台式供电、电路调试、性能测试和器件表征。
device_entry.description_en: A multi-channel programmable DC power supply that provides adjustable DC voltage and current output for electronic circuits, devices, and prototypes. It supports per-channel output control and output measurement, and is commonly used for bench power, circuit debugging, performance testing, and device characterization in laboratories.
